payload.summary: The draft revised policy as it was put to councillors in March 2026, 79 pages. It keeps the shape of the 2021 policy and adds sections on determining applications, on service standards, and on premises selling alcohol for drinking elsewhere, along with flow charts for new applications and for variations. It is the same document that was later published for public consultation, as a Word file.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 7 September 2026
